payload.recallText:
I am beginning my illustrious career as a journalist at Fordham University. I see the dean approaching. He currently has approved this policy which basically raises tuition prices, which hinders lower and middle class families and promotes a wealthier student body. I see him walk up and I'm like, "how does it feel to go against your own policy?". He goes, "hey, punk" and, out of the corner of my eye, I see a cream pie, flying towards the dean. The pie thrower runs off. I then as the dean, "care to comment on the attack?" and the dean comments, "Fuck you."

I then take the interview to my editor and he approves me writing it up. I might have embellished a little, but, in my story, Pie Man (capital 'P', capital 'M') walks up in a cape, creams the dean in the name of justice, recites "com nom en bestia" and exits the scene. My editor loved it. Pie Man loved it too. Pie Man said, "if you liked that, show up at this event". I definitely did. 

A girl that is rumored to have inappropriate relationships with university staff was there. She's not very popular after pushing a rule for "no beers at bar-be-ques". Needless to say, she was Pie Man's next victim.

Another night, I was at a party and saw a girl I have always been fond of. She stated that I always seem to know where the Pie Man will strike next, and then asked if I were the Pie Man. She asked in a way that, if I say, "Yes, I am the Pie Man", I know she'll sleep with me.
